lines.text: Like I wouldn't know they're there
If you want some golden loving
You might earn your place tonight
If you're wondering who owns it
Don't you put your body there
I might want to be alone
Either way the simple fact is
I got places I can go!
I'll retrieve it through the snow!
You're not as clever as I'm told
Sometimes when the lights go down
I hear him dreaming by the door
So who's really got it all?
Somebody throw it before he explodes.
